Skyt bobler opp på brettet. Henger tre e: Shoot bubbles up onto the board. When three or more alike touch, they pop – and everything that hung below them drops.
Dra fingeren over brettet. Den prikkete: Drag your finger over the board. The dotted line shows where the bubble will end up. Let go to shoot – the bubble bounces off the walls.
Lag en gruppe på tre eller flere med sam: Make a group of three or more with the same colour and shape. Bubbles that no longer hang from the ceiling drop and score double.
Prikkene nederst viser hvor mange bom du: The dots at the bottom show how many misses you have left before the ceiling comes down or a new row arrives. When the bubbles reach the line, the round is over – just have another go.
Trykk på den lille boblen ved siden av f: Tap the small bubble beside it to swap to the next one.
Bruk veggene: Et skudd i veggen kommer s: Use the walls: a shot off the wall often gets behind the other bubbles.
Skyt bort boblene som holder en stor kla: Pop the bubbles holding up a big bunch, and the whole bunch drops.
Hver boble har sin egen form, så du tren: Every bubble has its own shape, so you don't need to tell the colours apart.
Ombestemt deg? Dra fingeren ned under ut: Changed your mind? Drag your finger down below the launcher before you let go, and there's no shot.
Med tastatur: Piltastene sikter (hold Sh: With a keyboard: the arrow keys aim (hold Shift for fine aiming), Space or Enter shoots, X swaps the bubble and P pauses.
